interior_connectivity_diagnostic.scope: Additional interior connectivity; does not replace failure at the initial origin.
interior_connectivity_diagnostic.selection: Fixed checkpoint index supplied from the previous cycle; no relocation if a new map blocks it.

agent_diagnosis.conclusion: No improvement in integrated or withheld endpoint consistency from 24 particles in this seed; E16 remains the strongest measured consistency/cost reference, pending human geometric review.

hypotheses.result: Exactly identical raw grids, trajectory and PGM; new P95 122.25 ms instead of 404.25 ms. This tests reproducibility and the importance of comparable host load.
Particles alone did not improve endpoint consistency; reserved tail grew. All seeds are still untested.
Substantial endpoint regression despite shorter start-end separation and more admissible checkpoints. Those proxies must not independently select a map.
Integrated endpoints 95.90 to 95.32 percent, withheld 94.71 to 92.86 percent; p95 cost 122.25 to 201.25 ms. No improvement observed in this seed.

geometry: Room contour and three table rows remain visible in all maps.
D24 can look straighter at overview scale, but table edges and residuals disagree; human inspection is required.
Subtle wall thickness/continuity changes remain; same frame orientation is preserved without treating global rotations as ground-truth errors.
agent_diagnosis.navigation: Same checkpoints and frozen seed83 as cycle01. All admissible common checkpoints remain in one component. E16/F24/D24/E24 admit 88/84/104/86 of 181 respectively; origin footprint is blocked for all. Counts are conditional on estimated baseline positions and map deformation, not GT or validated coverage.
agent_diagnosis.trajectory: Start-end separation E16/F24/D24/E24: 21.33/21.14/17.33/21.82 cm. D24 has the smallest separation and worst endpoints. No absolute error or verified closure error is claimed.
agent_diagnosis.timing: Current cycle load was lower and more stable than cycle01. N24 core median 164-166 ms and p95 186-201 ms, over 137 ms on 93.25-99.07 percent of integrations. This misses the per-update budget but does not measure live ROS queue/drop behavior; movement gating skips many scans.
agent_diagnosis.stability: No invalid scans, rejected stamps, clipped rays or out-of-bounds particles. Mean ESS/N E16 .704, F24 .695, D24 .680, E24 .702; no evidence here that more particles alone improves map quality.
method_limitations: Seed 7 only; changing particle count changes random draw streams and the selected hypothesis.
Scan-match proposal is approximate with log(p/q)=0; particle count alone does not guarantee monotone quality.
Withheld scans are correlated with the fitted trajectory; no independent physical accuracy or GT.
agent_diagnosis.human_review_required: Inspect D24 versus E16 and historical H, especially table edges and top/bottom walls, before selecting finalists or new cycles.
